name: contract-page-viewport-matrix
goal: Reject page and layout states missing required desktop tablet or mobile screenshots

evidence: The visual-case admission introduced in 7ed8d6bc23 requires only a nonempty viewport list, so a page or layout state can omit required devices.
The existing layout case only checks a complete three-device row and never removes a device or tests different states; strengthen that same case and preserve component behavior.
The existing page and layout validation case fails at fbf95451e7 when a page state omits mobile, while the existing comparison cases still pass.
Group page rows by their actual state and input coordinates, require all three viewports per group, and retain the existing distinct-row and component checks.
Page rows are grouped by state, fixture, props, errors, call and input, then require desktop, tablet and mobile; component admission is unchanged.
The unchanged three existing cases pass at f0d901f117 after the page-missing-mobile failure at fbf95451e7; split rows and distinct prop coordinates are checked.
Isolated mutant 47384c4816 fails the unchanged page case (capture 54818f8f1860); restoring the fix at c455711c96 passes (capture c7af27b373a8).
